evidence.why: False updater result immediately invokes the finalizer.
Animation advancement and scale application precede the terminal check.
Finalizer ordering, current ground/air dispatch and damage callback installation.

facts.rationale: Replaces an unnecessarily delayed completion description and an unconditional grounded-exit claim with the actual updater ordering and finalizer branch.
facts.value: Each invocation advances and applies the auxiliary scale animation through fn_800D2A3C. If its post-update terminal-flag check returns false, the callback immediately invokes ftCo_800D15D0 in the same invocation; otherwise it makes no local outgoing transition. The finalizer commits giant status and its damage-dependent counter, restores saved movement before subsequent common cleanup, applies the endpoint scale, and selects continuation using the fighter's current ground_or_air. Damage can invoke the same finalizer early.
